name: Healing Spring · Fire
primary:
Places a totem (6 ❤) at the aim point for 22.5 s. Every second within 6 blocks, on everyone, including you:
• Damage 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 12 s
• Heals 3.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 12 s
• Growth: up to 10 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Revives the nearest fallen player or creature within 6 blocks with 39% health
• Puts out fire
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
The totem appears at your feet. Every second within 6 blocks, on everyone, including you:
• Soaked for 12 s
• Light push
• Heals 3.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 12 s
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 6.75 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
